svg.title: Striped cache: four stripes, each with its own lock and list
svg.desc: Threads T1 to T4 hash their keys to a stripe. T2 and T3 land on stripe 1, so T3 waits for T2. T1 and T4 use stripes 0 and 3 and wait for nobody. Stripe 2 is idle.
svg.text: stripe = hash(key) mod 4; only a shared stripe means waiting
each stripe holds 1/4 of the capacity and evicts by its own LRU order
